CHIEF COMPLAINT
Worsening shortness of breath, persistent cough, and increased fatigue.
HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Mr. Lysander Fairfax presents for follow-up three weeks after his previous visit. He reports that his shortness of breath has continued to worsen, particularly with minimal exertion. He describes episodes of breathlessness that occur even during activities of daily living, such as dressing and bathing. The patient states he has been using his albuterol inhaler approximately twenty times daily, indicating a significant increase in reliance on bronchodilators. His productive cough persists, with the sputum remaining greenish and occasionally blood-tinged, raising concerns for possible pneumonia or bronchitis.
Mr. Fairfax also notes a marked increase in fatigue, stating he feels exhausted after minimal activity. He continues to experience significant bilateral lower extremity edema, with the swelling now extending to his thighs. Additionally, he reports worsening insomnia, averaging only 1-2 hours of sleep per night, often due to anxiety related to his breathing difficulties.
